versions.changelog: Republish discovery-only scope with explicit safety guardrails.
Reduce scope to discovery/comparison only; remove checkout/payment execution; add explicit safety guardrails and no-secrets policy.
Expand trigger intents for generic event discovery queries (what's happening, things to do, weekend/tonight) and preference-based matching.
Initial release: discover PLVR events and assist ticket checkout with crypto wallet flow, reservation timer handling, and confirmation capture.
